mainText:
Good evening. Weather in Prishtina: 4 degrees now, broken clouds. Next 24 hours: high 13, low 2.

Turkey has officially ratified a defense agreement with Pakistan and Saudi Arabia, establishing a joint security framework among the three nations.

Albanian police have sealed off the perimeter of the Parliament building in Tirana, while protesters continue to gather and follow the security cordon.

Health experts warn that prediabetes can persist for years without symptoms, but lifestyle changes in diet, weight and exercise can lower the risk of progressing to type 2 diabetes.

The regional water utility in Gjakova announced that a repaired electricity fault has restored power to pumps, allowing water supply to resume in the villages of Dushkaja.

Joy Ryan, a 96-year-old from Ohio, completed her lifelong goal by traveling to all seven continents alongside her grandson.
